value.text:
Malda Medical College and Hospital (MMC&H) is a public medical college and hospital in Malda, West Bengal, India. Run by the government of West Bengal, it is affiliated with the West Bengal University of Health Sciences and is recognised by the National Medical Commission. Its premises are on Uma Roy Sarani in Malda Town. The institution combines medical education with hospital facilities serving the surrounding area.

The college was established in 2011. Following an inspection by an MCI team, its authority received a letter of permission on 30 June of that year, and first-year classes began on 1 August. These events distinguish the establishment of the college from the commencement of teaching. Construction work on the project had begun in November 2010.

The college offers undergraduate MBBS education and postgraduate MD and MS programmes. Its academic provision also includes nursing and paramedical diploma courses, with subjects such as medical laboratory technology, radiography and physiotherapy. The departmental structure covers pre-clinical, para-clinical and clinical disciplines, including anatomy, pathology, community medicine, general medicine and surgery. The campus includes an academic building, central library, lecture and practical teaching facilities, hospital buildings, a trauma centre and student accommodation.
